description: This file implements classes related to AWC (possibly 'Application Windows Controller') for handling state change notifications and listener callbacks within a process container context. It defines notifier and listener classes for AWC state changes, including managing listener registration, notification dispatch, and some stub methods for window changes.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Handles registration of listeners interested in AWC state changes and dispatches notifications to them.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Receives notifications about window changes and app state changes, acts upon them, and forwards state changes to a registered notifier.

methods.name: void addListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Registers a new AWCStateChangeListener, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: void notify(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners about a change in app state.

methods.name: void notifyWindowChange(int window_id VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,awc::AWCClient::awc_window_state_t window_state VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,unsigned int pid VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED)
methods.description: Stub method for window change notification, intentionally left blank.

methods.name: void notifyStateChange(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Logs and forwards application state change events to the notifier.

methods.name: void notifyServiceReady()
methods.description: Stub method indicating service readiness, no action performed.
